items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: The personnel of that band was Harold Brown, pianist, Bud Scott on banjo and guitar... The leader and director was a saxophonist and violinist, Leon Herniford.

ctx.x: In May 1947, I didn't play a single job, from October to May. About the middle of May, Kid Ory and his guitarist, Bud Scott--
